lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}

    rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]

    simp only [crAnTimeOrderList,

    arg 2

    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)

      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl
    have hc := (Set.ncard_le_ncard hs).trans Set.ncard_image_le
    simpa [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hammingDist, Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card'] using hc

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing c with
  | refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | par ha hb iha ihb =>
    cases h₂ with
    | par ha' hb' =>
      obtain ⟨_, ha₁, ha₂⟩ := iha ha'
      obtain ⟨_, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := ihb hb'
      exact ⟨_, .par ha₁ hb₁, .par ha₂ hb₂⟩
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    | red_I =>
      cases I_irreducible _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    | red_K =>
      obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K .., h⟩
    | red_S =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, h, h', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par h hb) (.par h' hb)⟩
  | _ =>
    cases h₂ with
    | par h h' =>
      first
      | cases I_irreducible _ h
        exact ⟨_, h', .red_I _⟩
      | obtain ⟨_, hr, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ h
        exact ⟨_, hr, .red_K ..⟩
      | obtain ⟨_, _, hr, hr', rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ h

  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => simp_all
  case abs => exact Or.inl (.abs lc)
  case tabs => exact Or.inl (.tabs lc)
  case sub => grind
  case' app l r ih₁ ih₂ =>
    cases lc
    rcases ih₁ rfl (by assumption) with v | ⟨_, h⟩ <;>
      rcases ih₂ rfl (by assumption) with v' | ⟨_, h'⟩
    case' inl.inl =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
      cases v
  case' tapp d s ih =>
    cases lc
    rcases ih rfl (by assumption) with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
      cases v
  case' let' d _ ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := body_let.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl (by assumption) with v | ⟨_, h⟩
  case' inl d _ ih | inr d _ ih =>
    cases lc
    rcases ih rfl (by assumption) with v | ⟨_, h⟩
  case' case d _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨_, _, _⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl (by assumption) with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    case' inl =>
      obtain ⟨_, h⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v
      cases h <;> subst_vars <;> cases v
  all_goals first | solve_by_elim [Or.inl, Value.inl, Value.inr] | right; exact ⟨_, by solve_by_elim (maxDepth := 8) [Red.appₗ, Red.appᵣ, Red.abs, Red.tabs, Red.tapp, Red.let_bind, Red.let_body, Red.inl, Red.inr, Red.case, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr]⟩

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  unfold fiberwiseClose fiberwiseDistance at h_fw_dist_lt
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
    (s := (fun g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ =>
      (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ)
  have hb : hammingDist f g ≤ (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
    let Q := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := by dsimp; have := pos_of_neZero 𝓡; omega)
    have hs : {x | f x ≠ g.val x} ⊆ (fun p => Q p.1 p.2) '' (Y ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin (2 ^ steps)))) := by
      intro x hx
      refine ⟨⟨iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x, pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ steps h_i_add_steps x⟩, ⟨⟨x, rfl, hx⟩, trivial⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl
    have hc := (Set.ncard_le_ncard hs).trans Set.ncard_image_le
    rw [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin] at hc
    change (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g.val x)).card ≤ _
    rw [← Set.ncard_coe_finset]
    simpa only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hc
  have he : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
      BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ - 1 := by
    dsimp [BBF_CodeDistance]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add]
    congr 1 <;> congr 1 <;> omega
  unfold hammingClose
  have hd : Code.distFromCode f (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) ≤ (hammingDist f g : ℕ∞) := sInf_le ⟨g, g.property, le_rfl⟩
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (bot_le : (0 : ℕ∞) ≤ 2))
  change ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ↑(hammingDist f g) < _
  rw [← ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
  have hf := ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt
  rw [← hg] at hf
  exact Nat.lt_of_le_pred (Nat.succ_pos _) ((Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hb).trans (by
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_pred_of_lt hf)).trans_eq he))

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  refine (⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice ·, ?_⟩)
  rintro _ _ (h | h) _ <;> constructor <;> intro s t
  case' choice.left | choice.right => cases t <;> rename_i t
  case choiceR | choiceR => exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR t, .bisim (.refl _)⟩
  all_goals
    apply Exists.imp
    rotate_left
    first | exact h.follow_fst t | exact h.follow_snd t
    intro
    apply And.imp _ ChoiceBisim.bisim
    first | exact Tr.choiceL | exact id

(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have swap (x y : _ → ℤ) i :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then y j else x j) =
      digits_to_num x + (y i * 10 ^ i.1 - x i * 10 ^ i.1) := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  intro d e f ⟨hd, he⟩
  simp only [hrelation, swap] at hd he
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd.2 i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_fin, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num] at hs
  intro i
  apply (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 by decide).pow_right.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  convert dvd_sub (dvd_sub hs (dvd_add (hd.2 i) (he.2 i))) (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d)) using 1
  ring1
